evaluation.uncertainty_unit: world seed; all opponents and seats remain in one cluster

acceptance_gates.coverage: all 384 cells complete, 720 states/719 decisions, no exceptions
acceptance_gates.primary: candidate total score strictly greater than B1 total score
acceptance_gates.cluster_uncertainty: one-sided 90% bootstrap lower bound of mean seed-cluster point delta is >= 0
acceptance_gates.opponent_guardrail: candidate paired point delta is >= -1.0 for every opponent family (48 games each)
acceptance_gates.margin_guardrail: overall mean paired margin delta is greater than -250
acceptance_gates.transition_guardrail: candidate creates at most 2 baseline-win to candidate-loss transitions
acceptance_gates.effective_change: candidate changes at least one final action and reports zero policy errors

notes: The four opponents are source-lineage related and are not counted as independent uncertainty units.
No thresholds, opponent identities, seeds, or sample size may be changed after inspecting holdout results.
A passing local holdout does not establish a 2500/3000 public rating prediction.
